translation: The so-called accumulation of today is just like making the goiter and tumor grow internally instead; can one not call it all an accumulation of qi and blood? Can one rely solely on the power of medicine to disperse it? In sum, all the hundred diseases take qi and blood as primary. If it flows, there is no accumulation; if it does not flow, there is accumulation. If new, the accumulation is small; if old, the accumulation is large. Regardless of large or small, internal or external disease, if one can truly rub it so that the channels and collaterals and qi and blood flow freely, then there is no disease that will not be cured. There is no need to first dispute the name and the ancient-modern distinction of this rubbing of accumulation. Let me further explain with something shallow and near: for headache, rub and lift the temple (太陽) and the space between the brows (眉心), and one immediately feels light and refreshed; for sore throat, lift the front of the neck heavily, and one also sees effect; for a small swelling, pain, sore, or boil, rubbing it disperses it at once.
